correctness.rationale: Diagonalizing path Laplacian gives spectral eigenvalues 0,1,3 and endpoint projector entries (1/3,-1/2,1/6), confirming F. Since amplitude >=-1/3 and equals +1 only at incompatible s=odd*pi and sqrt3*s=even*pi, there is no finite perfect transfer. A bounded s²(1-F) sequence must concentrate at those phases, with errors u,v=O(1/s). Expand loss D=1-A=u²/4+v²/12+O(s^-4); exact identity u²/4+v²/12-(v-sqrt3 u)²/24=(sqrt3 u+v)²/24 yields 1-F >=Delta²/12+O(s^-4). For odd q even p, Delta=pi(sqrt3 q-p), |p²-3q²|>=1 gives liminf s²Delta²>=pi^4/12 and target pi^4/144. Pell p+q sqrt3=(2+sqrt3)^(2n+1) has p even, q odd, norm1; choose u=-Delta/(2sqrt3), v=Delta/2 to saturate quadratic bound. Nine independently generated Pell samples converge to target. The source wave-envelope approximation is not uniformly verified at growing physical times.
